title: Extra-Name Bands on Multi-Year Second-Key Orders
content:
*Footnote to the second-key pricing schedule, SSL/TLS Certificates (multi-domain products).*

**Rule.** The extra names of a second-key order running more than one year are billed in bands for each year of the second-key term. The bands follow the number of extra names the sibling subscription records:

- where the sibling records **more than 50** extra names, the first 10 are billed at the product's price per added name per year, those after them up to the 50th at 60 percent of that price, and those beyond the 50th at 40 percent of it;
- where the sibling records **more than 10 but no more than 50** extra names, the first 10 are billed at the product's price per added name per year and the rest at 60 percent of it;
- a second-key order with a **one-year** term, or a sibling recording **10 extra names or fewer**, bills every extra name at the product's price per added name per year.

The bands set the yearly billing of the extra names of the second-key order; they apply to each year of the term alike.

**Band table (per year of the second-key term).**

| Second-key term | Extra names on the sibling | Names 1 to 10 | Names 11 to 50 | Names 51 and beyond |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| one year | any number | full name price | full name price | full name price |
| two or three years | 10 or fewer | full name price | not applicable | not applicable |
| two or three years | 11 to 50 | full name price | 60 percent | not applicable |
| two or three years | 51 or more | full name price | 60 percent | 40 percent |

**Boundary cases.**

- 10 extra names on a two-year term: no band applies, every name at the full price. 11 extra names: the eleventh name is billed at 60 percent.
- 50 extra names on a three-year term: names 11 to 50 at 60 percent and none at 40 percent. 51 extra names: the 51st is billed at 40 percent.
- 63 extra names on a one-year term: all 63 at the full price, since the bands apply only to a term of more than one year.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A sibling records 63 extra names and the second-key term is two years; suppose, for illustration only, a price per added name per year of USD 7.30. In each year the first 10 names come to USD 73.00, the next 40 names at 60 percent (USD 4.38 each) come to USD 175.20, and the last 13 names at 40 percent (USD 2.92 each) come to USD 37.96, so the extra names are billed USD 286.16 for each year of the term.
